| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **JPEG quality** `quality` | 50 | 1 to 100 | The quality the image was saved with, from 1 to 100, as in the IJG library. It sets the quantization tables of the deblocking step. |
| **Shifts per axis** `shifts` | 8 (64 grids) | 1 (1 grid), 2 (4 grids), 4 (16 grids), 8 (64 grids) | How many shifts of the 8 x 8 grid the deblocking step averages along each axis. |
| **Deblock channels** `channels` | Y, Cb and Cr | Y, Cb and Cr, Luma only | Which planes of the Y'CbCr of JFIF the deblocking step processes. |
| **Edge threshold** `threshold` | 20 | 1 to 200 | Strong edges are where the gradient of the smoothed luma reaches this many levels per pixel. |
| **Zone radius** `radius` | 4 | 1 to 15 px | How far from a strong edge the smoothing reaches. Ringing of JPEG stays within its 8 x 8 block. |
| **Range sigma** `sigmaColor` | 25 | 1 to 100 | The range sigma of the bilateral filter, in pixel values. Differences well above it are kept. |
| **Space sigma** `sigmaSpace` | 2 | 0.5 to 6 px | The spatial sigma of the bilateral filter. Its window has a radius of ceil(2 sigma). |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
